entries.category_description: Provision, construction, renovation and alteration of housing, as part of a social policy
entries.comment: Under the conditions provided for in Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, category XXXVII, the demolition and reconstruction of private dwellings and the supply of reconstructed private dwellings, to the entire Belgian territory, to be mainly used as domicile by the builder/buyer or destined to be leased long-term (for social purposes or not) by the builder/buyer.
